dedupe_keys.name: planar trench geothermal thermal response test april 2022

description: The planar-trench collector research team publishes measurements from an April 2022 thermal response test. Coverage is one collector and its surrounding ground during this test. The Zenodo description names PT100 sensors, fibre-optic temperature measurements, thermistors, volumetric water content and bulk electrical conductivity of the surrounding ground. The test involved fluid circulation and injected heat. One archive is available free under CC BY 4.0. These observations can calibrate ground heat-transfer parameters for shallow geothermal and building-energy simulations, with model-energyplus a related building context. A caveat is that one trench, soil and operating interval cannot establish performance across seasons or other ground conditions. Sensor depth, heat-input history and moisture response must be checked in the files before fitting a model. The public metadata and package manifest were read without downloading the archive. Later campaigns are distinct deposits and are assessed separately.
